title: Certify a whole coupled fibre with finite rational arithmetic
statement: For rational nu,T,delta>0 and fixed noncritical fibre choose computable rational b>=||B_A||. Heat Duhamel and adjoint smoothing give ||Gamma^1/2 S_A(T)||<=exp(bT)[(2T)^-1/2+b(2T)^1/2]. Discarded input/output norm outside |m|<=R in BOTH components is<=2exp(bT)[(2T)^-1/2+b(2T)^1/2]/[kappa sqrt(nu)(R+1)]. Pay finite R for error<delta/16. Bandwidth-one Dyson terms through Q0 agree on the central block inside R+Q0; remainder<=2sum_(n>Q0)(bT)^n/n! pays another delta/16. Finite rational exponential/pi/root arithmetic pays another delta/16. Certify (delta/2)^2 I-F*F strictly positive by exact rational real-block LDL/Sylvester arithmetic. Every bad amplitude is rejected after finite work; enumerating integer A terminates because true full norm is eventually<delta/4. Finite promised encodings give a computable recursive complete-bit bound, not polynomial or practical. Small operator norm does not force dimension-uniform small Hilbert-Schmidt norm; this corrects the raw E104 test.
